name: Reverse Pec Deck Fly
steps: Set the handles for a reverse fly and sit facing the pad with your chest supported and handles at shoulder height.
Reach forward to grasp the handles with a neutral or overhand grip and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms smoothly backward in a wide arc until they align with your torso, squeezing your rear delts and upper back.
Control the handles slowly back to the starting position without letting the weight stack touch down.
tips: Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears instead of shrugging into your upper traps.
Stop once your arms are roughly in line with your back rather than pinching your shoulder blades together excessively.
